items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Ella came, Sonny Stitt, Joe Jones, Dizzy Gillespie, Gene Krupa, Stan Getz. ... I had never met Stan Getz and he came up and asked me... and all of these and Flip Phillips, very nice, and Lester Young, they were all so pleasant. Hawkins, they all came to see me

ctx.x: Well, you know, he got his stable one way or another, didn't he?

No, Granz came in, I remember, I was playing -- this is during all this, jumping to Europe, being with George, and we'd go to Canada quite a lot, and I was -- go to Toronto -- I was playing at a place called the Town Tavern in Toronto, which certainly you know, and on the night I opened there, the Jazz at the Philharmonic played Massey Hall and the whole show came over. I'll never forget Dizzy -- these were all younger people and they all seemed to know me, and they came over. It was such a marvelous thing, and…

Just marvelous people in the show and there were -- they sold out the room. Ella came, Sonny Stitt, Joe Jones, Dizzy Gillespie, Gene Krupa, Stan Getz. I had never met Stan Getz and he came up and asked me, 'Well, how do you get that big note out of that horn,' and I said, 'I think it's due to a leak in the horn.' And he was so nice to me, and all of these and Flip Phillips, very nice, and Lester Young, they were all so pleasant.
